Subject: Renewal + reserved pool expansion — initial proposal

Laura / AstraSynth procurement team —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our call, please find attached a short proposal that bundles your upcoming renewal (annual term starting 2026-09-01) with the dedicated capacity expansion you requested: +12 x A100-equivalent GPU reservation (bringing the pool to 24 GPUs), updated throughput guarantee for the reserved pool, and a co-term billing approach so the expansion is consolidated on the renewal schedule.

Key bullets from the proposal: 
- Reserved pool: increase from 12 -> 24 GPUs (A100-eq)
- Throughput guarantee: sustained baseline of X tokens/sec per-GPU during business hours; automated burst policy for spiky traffic
- Billing: single PO and invoicing cadence aligned to renewal date (see two options below)
- Price: expansion amortized over the 12-month term; one-time activation fee waived if PO signed by 2026-08-15

Attached: AstraSynth_Renewal_Expansion_Proposal.pdf (proposal + model/instance appendix).

Two billing options for procurement to consider (high level):
1) Co-term single PO — new PO amendment that covers both renewal and expansion, invoice monthly (standard) with the expansion amortized over the full term (simpler from an accounting perspective).
2) One-time expansion charge + co-termed renewal — upfront charge for the additional GPUs prorated to the renewal date, then renewal invoiced on your existing schedule.

Can you let me know which option works for you? If you prefer, I can put together a PO amendment draft and loop in finance/legal. Ben and Rishi are cc'd to help move the amendment + invoice schedule.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa / Priyom / Rishi —

I pulled together the core amendment language we typically use for co-terming reserved pools (see bullets below). Priyom — can you turn this into a one-page PO amendment and attach to the next send? Rishi — FYI on billing notes.

Suggested amendment highlights (summary):
- Amendment to existing Agreement (Contract # AS-2024-019): add 12 A100-eq GPUs to Redwood Reserved Pool for AstraSynth, effective 2026-09-01. Total reserved pool after amendment: 24 GPUs.
- Billing: total expansion cost will be amortized over the remainder of the co-term period and invoiced according to the selected cadence (monthly or quarterly). Any partial-month activation will be prorated on a per-day basis.
- Throughput SLA: Redwood guarantees baseline sustained throughput per reserved GPU during business hours (Mon-Fri 08:00-18:00 PT); see appendix for measurable metrics and remediation credits.
- Activation: Ops will provision additional capacity within 10 business days following receipt of signed amendment and PO.
- Early termination / buyout: standard buyout schedule if customer terminates before end of term.

Notes on quarterly billing: We can support quarterly invoicing but that requires an explicit line item in the amendment and an invoice schedule table in the PO to map amortized amounts to quarter dates. Rishi — can you confirm the accounting code we should use for quarterly invoices so we align the invoice footer and GL mapping?

Attachment: none yet; happy to review Priyom's draft.

-ben
